data.name: ImmortalCultivationSimulator
data.detailed_description:
Warning! This game is still in Early Access and may contain numerous bugs and limited content. Please purchase with caution, fellow cultivators.

This language is not currently supported.

この言語は現在サポートされていません。

현재 이 언어는 지원되지 않습니다.

Cette langue n’est pas prise en charge actuellement.

Diese Sprache wird derzeit nicht unterstützt.

Este idioma no está disponible actualmente.

Este idioma não é suportado atualmente.

В настоящее время этот язык не поддерживается.

Enter a Cultivation World That Remembers You

You begin as an unknown cultivator taking your first steps on the path to immortality.

Ahead lies a long road through ever-higher realms—and a cultivation world that does not revolve around you alone. Some cultivate in seclusion to break through. Some toil for their sects. Some fight over opportunities in secret realms. Others remember the help you once gave them, or wait to settle an old debt.

You may devote yourself to cultivation and seek lost inheritances, or join a sect, befriend fellow cultivators, gather intelligence, and explore secret realms. The roads you travel, the choices you make, and the karma you create will become your personal cultivation record.

Begin at Qi Refining and Walk Your Own Path

Cultivation is more than endlessly raising numbers.

Secluded cultivation takes time. Breakthroughs require preparation. Powerful cultivation methods and divine abilities must be found through inheritances, while pills, equipment, and artifacts are acquired step by step through materials and opportunity.

From Qi Refining to Ascension, every realm brings new goals and risks. You must balance lifespan, time, energy, and resources—and prepare for your next breakthrough.

Will you advance steadily through careful planning, or gamble on an opportunity powerful enough to change your fate? The choice is yours.

Build Your Own Cultivation Style

No single build can handle every enemy.

Choose a direction through your cultivation methods, then combine divine abilities, equipment, and combat pills. Before every duel, study your opponent, judge the threat, and cover your weaknesses.

Against enemies built around burst damage, control, attrition, or defense, realm alone does not decide victory. The right divine ability—or a pill prepared beforehand—may turn the battle around.

Every duel tests the results of your cultivation and shows you what to improve next.

Travel the Continents and Seek Opportunity Amid Danger

Towns, markets, sects, caves, monster lairs, and procedurally generated secret realms are scattered across the world map.

On the road, you may discover strange spiritual disturbances, hear a rumor, or follow an unverified lead. But true opportunity does not simply fall into your inventory—investigation costs energy, trade costs spirit stones, and going deeper into a secret realm may bring corruption, disorientation, and battle. Fighting over treasure may also earn you the hatred of others seeking it.

You can walk away, or accept the cost and continue.

Some choices bring materials, inheritances, and treasures. Others may leave you with only an enemy searching for you.

Forge Bonds in the Cultivation World—and Bear the Weight of Favors and Grudges

The people you meet are not merely names waiting for interaction.

They have their own sects, relationships, histories, and circumstances. They cultivate, trade, make connections, and make choices in their own lives.

You may speak with them, gather information, trade privately, or spar in battle. You may take a master, accept disciples, or become Dao companions. One act of aid may grow into a lasting favor; one fight over treasure may become an old grudge that follows you across continents.

The world will not reveal every change to you directly. Only by truly knowing someone, joining a sect, or gaining the right intelligence will the stories connected to you gradually come to light.

From Sect Disciple to Ruler of Your Own Domain

You may join a sect, begin as an ordinary disciple, complete assignments, earn contribution, and compete for a position. When the time is right, you may also establish a sect of your own.

Different positions bring different responsibilities. Sect buildings, departmental affairs, disciples’ situations, resource pressures, and external relations gradually emerge through quests, monthly reports, and intelligence.

Helping fellow disciples and addressing a sect’s needs can earn contribution and prestige. Harming fellow disciples or fighting over interests may bring accountability.

A sect offers more than cultivation methods and rewards—it becomes your identity, your stance, and your ties to the cultivation world.

Your Choices Leave Visible Consequences

The quests you complete, battles you fight, favors you owe or earn, enemies you attract, and actions you take within your sect will all return to shape your journey.

NPC attitudes will change. New commissions and intelligence will appear. Sect monthly reports will record your influence. Old enemies may trace your trail and close in. Your defining experiences will be written into your personal record and the world’s evaluation of you.

You may build goodwill far and wide, or live by vengeance and impulse. You may become the pillar of a sect, or wander the world alone. You may abandon an opportunity for safety—or rewrite your fate with a single bold gamble.

The Great Dao is long.

In this life, how will you cultivate?

data.short_description: Xiuxian Simulator is a single-player cultivation RPG of exploration, growth, and tactical combat. Begin as an unknown Qi Refining cultivator, seek techniques and treasures, join or found a sect, explore hidden realms, form bonds, and leave a lasting mark on a world that remembers your choices.
